title: Design an AI-assisted help desk (self-service + agent assist)
scenario: LFG's steering committee approved Amazon Connect but not the AI features: the Lex pilot contained 9% and every transfer lost context, InfoSec has three conditions and the budget owner wants a cost per contact. Write the lead architect's design for self-service and agent assist with Lex, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, AI agents (formerly Amazon Q in Connect) and ServiceNow.
task: Scope drivers into deterministic self-service, RAG answers and agent assist with targets
Architecture diagram with managed vs custom components and regions
Handoff contract to the agent workspace and ServiceNow
Entitlement-aware retrieval, guardrails, injection handling, logging and retention
Latency budget, evaluation plan with gates, cost per contact with sensitivity
Phased rollout, RACI with the offshore team, decisions and risks
acceptance: Rubric only: grade.sh reports 0/0 and a completeness report
Current, correct capabilities with no invented features
Numbers derived from inputs/ with prices flagged as illustrative

practices.label: Week 5 - Lex V2, Bedrock, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails
